sources.finding: The pinned README documents a multi-platform desktop workspace, CLI, paired iPhone/Android/browser companion, parallel coding-agent CLIs and worktrees, GitHub workflow and AGPL source.

sources.title: Pragma apps-www-content-docs-user-guide-quick-start-mdx
sources.locator: Create a worktree; review changes; ship and clean up
sources.finding: Pragma creates a worktree and terminal with a prompt, can use SSH projects, displays actual file diffs, stages/commits/pushes and opens PRs.

sources.title: Pragma apps-www-content-docs-user-guide-agent-board-mdx
sources.locator: Columns; Starting a card; Completing a card; Cards and everything else
sources.finding: Draft prompts, per-worktree cards, manual state overrides and categories persist in desktop database. Cards represent worktrees, not a separate issue system; GitHub issue suggestions are only saved when accepted.

sources.title: Pragma apps-www-content-docs-user-guide-github-mdx
sources.locator: Signing in; Creating a pull request; Reviewing; Watch, fix and merge
sources.finding: Product GitHub OAuth/gh auth, diff review, commit/push/PR creation and merge controls are documented. Watch/fix/merge waits for all checks on the latest commit, respects GitHub permissions and runs only while desktop is open.

sources.title: Pragma apps-www-content-docs-automations-index-mdx
sources.finding: Host-server-supervised TypeScript automations use cron or events, approved through Settings. Cron ticks 20 seconds; no retry queue is promised.

sources.title: Pragma apps-www-content-docs-plugins-agents-mdx
sources.locator: defineAgent; resume; Watchers status and round trips
sources.finding: Agent plugins declare launch arguments, resume argv and watchers. Product sidecars parse status and send interjections to the native coding-agent TUI.

sources.title: Pragma license
sources.finding: The application license is GNU AGPL version 3. The application package manifests explicitly select AGPL-3.0-only.

sources.title: Pragma apps-pragma-package-json
sources.locator: license field and desktop runtime dependencies
sources.finding: The desktop package specifies license AGPL-3.0-only. Selected dependency manifest inspection contains no analytics/crash-reporting SDK declaration.

sources.title: Pragma apps-www-src-app-(home)-privacy-page-tsx
sources.locator: The short version; Analytics and diagnostics; website exception
sources.finding: Public policy source says neither desktop nor Pragma Go collects analytics, usage statistics or crash reports. The marketing/docs website is separately instrumented with Reddit/Vercel analytics and region-dependent consent.
